candidates.name: decrease_collision_high_penalty
candidates.hypothesis: Reducing the collision high penalty will encourage smoother interactions between cars.
candidates.rationale: A less severe penalty may allow agents to be more lenient with minimizing contact while racing.

candidates.name: increase_overtake_bonus
candidates.hypothesis: Increasing the overtake bonus will motivate agents to focus on clean overtaking behavior.
candidates.rationale: A higher reward for overtaking can encourage more aggressive yet safely executed passes.

candidates.name: reduce_brake_penalty_scale
candidates.hypothesis: Lowering the brake penalty scale will promote more frequent braking, allowing for better cornering control.
candidates.rationale: Encouraging braking can help agents avoid throttle saturation in tight turns.
